records.representativeIntroduction: 石松（Lycopodium clavatum L.）是石松科在本图谱中的代表物种。插画以单个完整标本呈现，重点保留匍匐或横展的茎叶、可见的繁殖结构等可见形态，便于从茎干与枝条、繁殖结构、整体株形辨认这张代表图像；这些线索不意味着该科所有物种都具有完全相同的外观。该物种沿用图谱既有的代表种选择。该代表记录未附可用的 GBIF 出现计数。

It is placed under Apiales, within Angiospermae, following the classification backbone recorded for this atlas. Myodocarpaceae is accepted here at family rank in the APG IV (2016) backbone. The entry uses Myodocarpus fraxinifolius as its visual representative and keeps flowers or inflorescences, fruits or seeds visible in the plate. Compare it with neighboring families through leaf form, flowers and inflorescences, fruits or seeds; this is an illustrated guide for exploration, not a substitute for a full botanical diagnosis or field identification.

The representative follows the atlas selection policy for accepted species. The linked GBIF record currently summarizes 721 occurrences.
